messages:
sofia (Platform PM): Quick sync — we need a concrete mapping from plan -> quota profile for the billing change. Main ask: define burst behavior for Free / Pro / Enterprise so Console and API headers can show clear state.

lin (eng-platform): Broad idea: Free = low sustained + small burst, Pro = higher sustained + larger burst, Enterprise = contractual (effectively no burst limit unless specified). Need numbers though.

ajay (infra): Proposed defaults (we can tweak):
- Free: 60 req/min, ~2k tokens/min, burst up to 500 tokens per request, 60s cooldown on burst.
- Pro: 600 req/min, ~50k tokens/min, burst up to 10k tokens with leaky-bucket enforcement.
- Enterprise: configurable per-contract, default: 10k req/min, 2M tokens/min, burst unlimited (subject to org-level caps).

sofia (Platform PM): Can we express those as policy objects for the Console? Example preview: 
```yaml
plans:
  free:
    rps: 1
    tokens_per_min: 2000
    burst_tokens: 500
  pro:
    rps: 10
    tokens_per_min: 50000
    burst_tokens: 10000
  enterprise:
    rps: 166
    tokens_per_min: 2000000
    burst_tokens: null
```

lin (eng-platform): Looks good. Two decisions: enforcement unit = per-api-key vs per-org? And headers: we should expose bucket state for UX (remaining, reset).

ajay (infra): Implementation note: enforcement = per-key for Free/Pro, per-org aggregate for Enterprise (so customers can rotate keys). We'll do dual checks: per-key then org-aggregate.

elaine (billing): From billing side we need monthly token caps for Pro (soft cap + overage pricing) vs Enterprise (hard caps configurable). Also need the user-facing messaging: throttled vs billed.

frank (sre): Ops concern: granting burst from a shared KV store causes thundering herd risk. Suggest probabilistic backoff on burst grants + jittered retries in SDKs. Also add metrics for burst-grant-failures.

lin (eng-platform): We already have a leaky-bucket middleware. Add a burst-controller that consults the plan policy store and tags metrics with plan/plan_tier/org_id.

sofia (Platform PM): UX ask: Console should show "Burst tokens remaining" and when hitting burst limits show explicit upgrade CTA. Also alert when aggregate usage >90% of committed capacity for Dedicated/Enterprise.

ajay (infra): I'll add response headers: `X-Quota-Remaining`, `X-Quota-Reset`, `X-Burst-Remaining`. Use RFC-like integer values. SDKs can surface these.

ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled a test cluster: quota-tiers-e2e on 2026-03-20T02:00Z for canary tests.

lin (eng-platform): Plan: PoC by EOD Friday, infra PR from ajay within 48h, SRE tests from frank after infra PR, billing messages from elaine for Console strings.

sofia (Platform PM): Sounds good — timeline pinned. Thanks all :thumbsup:

elaine (billing): Quick note — need a small copy update for the pricing page explaining burst semantics (billing vs throttle). I'll draft and drop in #marketing once specs are final.

frank (sre): Also we should add a synthetic test that simulates many small bursts to ensure leaky-bucket + burst-controller doesn't allow unbounded amplification.

lin (eng-platform): Noted. I'll add metrics: `quota.burst.granted` / `quota.burst.denied` / `quota.token.used` with plan tag.

ajay (infra): I'll put a small JSON policy example in the PR, and wire the headers. Trying to keep the runtime check fast (single KV read + local cached tokens).

sofia (Platform PM): Great — closing this thread. If anything slips, re-open or ping me directly.
